_comment: Which git-pinned components the pin-bump bot moves forward, and which it leaves alone. Every component pinned by repository plus revision must appear in exactly one of the two maps: scripts/bump-pins.py refuses to run otherwise, so a new pin cannot go unnoticed in either direction.

untracked.isl: a third-party release tag; moves with the GCC dependency set, by hand
untracked.vdpm: a released tag; the vdpm release process moves it, and the core embeds the matching bundle
untracked.vita-makepkg: a reviewed revision; its packaging assumptions are load-bearing for the core package
